integrity: Analytic proof from polar linearization, weighted-periodic Laplace limits and a uniform blow-up ratio. Accompanying numerical and symbolic checker supplies finite consistency checks, not an independent proof or publication certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the given rotating cubic polynomial family, nonzero anisotropy and positive linear and angular coefficients; no general perturbation theorem, higher-dimensional extension or independent publication-priority certificate.
title: Bessel-normalized two-sided escape clocks in a rotating cubic star-node flow
